spec2def(msadp32.acm msadp32.acm.spec)

# msadp32.acm is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msadp32_acm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msadp32.acm_shims OBJECT msadp32.c)
target_link_libraries(msadp32.acm_shims PRIVATE wine libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(msadp32.acm_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro
add_cargo_module(msadp32.acm msadp32_acm-cargo msadp32.acm
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msadp32.acm_shims psdk)
